subject: Renewal: MeridianAI — price protection & capacity uptier
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha@meridianai.com>
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal planning — ask on price protection + temporary uptier

Hi Neha,

Hope you had a good weekend. Meridian's execs want to lock renewal discussion this month — we're looking at the current commitment through 2027 and evaluating a short-term uptier for Q2 to support a major product launch. Two asks from our side: 1) price protection (hold current unit rates) for a 6-month window starting on the renewal effective date, and 2) temporary capacity uptier (roughly +45% tokens for 3 months) with offsetting credits so the near-term cost impact is small.

Attached is our internal renewal request summary (Meridian_Renewal_Request_2027.pdf) with projected usage and preferred cadence for true-ups (quarterly). Can Redwood outline a proposal that includes: proposed price-hold duration, credit amount for the 3-month uptier, and how commit changes would be handled for the remainder of the year?

We can do a call Tue/Wed this week. Please loop in anyone on your side I should expect.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Head of Procurement, MeridianAI
Samantha.lee@meridianai.com
procurement@meridianai.com

Attachment: Meridian_Renewal_Request_2027.pdf (summary, 2 pages)
From: neha.kapoor@redwood.com
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@meridianai.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 10:38:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — ask on price protection + temporary uptier

Hi Samantha — thanks for the context and the attachment. We're excited to help support the launch. Quick summary of what we can commit to and open questions below; happy to hop on a 30-minute call Tue 2pm PT if that works.

Proposal (high level):
- Price protection: a 4-month guaranteed hold at current unit rates from the renewal effective date, with an option to extend to 6 months if Meridian accepts a small staggered commit increase (details in the attached proposal).
- Uptier for launch: we can offer a temporary +45% burst capacity for 3 months with a credit equal to 20% of the expected incremental spend for that window (applied as a billing credit over the following invoice).
- Commit handling: uplift can be modeled as a temporary tranche that decays into the customer's base commit at a negotiated conversion rate (we usually do 50% conversion of remaining uplift into base commit unless a different true-up is agreed).

Open items we need from you: projected month-by-month token profile for the uptier months (to size credits), and confirmation on true-up cadence (quarterly looks fine).

I've attached our draft proposal (RDW-Proposal-Meridian-v4.pdf) with line-item math and two alternative term-sets: Option A (4-month hold + 3-month uptier credits) and Option B (6-month hold with a smaller credit and a 12-month commit uplift). Marcus from Finance is copied for the accounting treatment; Marissa will lead commercial and signatures.

Next steps: 1) please confirm Tue 2pm PT or propose another time; 2) if you can share the projected uptier usage by EOD Tue, we'll finalize numbers before the call.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive — Renewals
Redwood Inference

From: marissa.cole@redwood.com

Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 08:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — ask on price protection + temporary uptier

Samantha — thanks for surfacing this. Adding specifics so you have concrete options to discuss with the exec team.

Option A (Accelerated Launch Support)
- Price hold: 4 months at current rates from renewal effective date.
- Uptier: +45% capacity for months 1-3 of the renewal. Credit: 20% of incremental spend for months 1-3 applied as a billing credit across months 4-6.
- Commit conversion: 50% of unused uptier converts to base commit at the end of month 3 unless Meridian requests otherwise.
- Docs: will require a short amendment to the MSA (renewal addendum) and a DocuSign for the credit schedule.

Option B (Extended Protection + Commit Uplift)
- Price hold: 6 months if Meridian agrees to a staged commit uplift (15% increase for first 6 months, then review).
- Uptier credit: 12% of incremental spend (lower credit in exchange for longer protection).
- Commit conversion: staged conversion where 30% of uptier converts to base commit at month 4 and the remainder at month 7 subject to usage.

Operational notes:
- Finance (Marcus) flagged that credits will be applied as contra-invoice items; we will provide a one-page accounting memo for your procurement and finance teams.
- We can do quarterly true-ups; if Meridian prefers monthly true-ups we can operationalize that but it will change the credit amortization timing.

I attached a tighter redline-ready term sheet (Meridian_Renewal_Termsheet_redlines.docx). If this looks directionally OK, we'll prepare the DocuSign packet and mark up the contract.

I recommend we lock Option A quickly to ensure the launch is covered and then evaluate Option B in 60 days if the usage trajectory supports it.

Marissa Cole
Strategic Account Lead
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachment: Meridian_Renewal_Termsheet_redlines.docx (term sheet, 2 pages)
From: Samantha Lee <samantha@meridianai.com>

Cc: procurement@meridianai.com
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — ask on price protection + temporary uptier

Neha / Marissa — appreciate the quick turnaround and clear options. Meridian's CFO and Head of Product reviewed the two options overnight. A few notes / counterpoints:

- We prefer a 6-month price protection window to cover ramp uncertainty — the launch could slip and we need coverage through peak planning. If Redwood will only do 4 months, we need the credit to be larger (closer to 28% incremental credit) rather than 20%.
- On commit conversion: Meridian cannot accept an automatic 50% conversion of unused uptier into base commit. We can agree to convert up to 25% by default, with any further conversion only by written agreement after the Q3 review.
- True-ups: quarterly is fine. However, we need invoice credits to be applied no later than the next invoice after the uptier period ends (i.e., month 4).

Attached are a few redlines to the term sheet; legal will need to review the DocuSign packet. If you can produce an updated proposal reflecting: 6-month hold OR 4-month hold + 28% credit, and the 25% conversion cap, we can expedite.

Samantha
Samantha Lee
Head of Procurement, MeridianAI
procurement@meridianai.com

Date: Fri, 19 Feb 2027 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — ask on price protection & capacity uptier (final proposal)

Samantha — thank you and thanks to your team for the clear redlines. We discussed internally and here's what Redwood can commit to for a final offer so you can take it to legal/CFO:

Final Offer (signed term amendment + DocuSign):
- Price protection: 6-month price hold at current unit rates, conditional on Meridian agreeing to the staged commit uplift described below.
- Staged commit uplift: 15% uplift to base commit for the first 6 months (to be captured in the amendment). If utilization after month 6 supports it, we will convert an additional discretionary tranche (up to another 10%) by mutual written agreement after Q3 review.
- Uptier for launch: +45% burst capacity months 1-3. Credit: 25% of incremental spend for months 1-3 applied as a contra-invoice credit on month 4 invoice. (This is a mix of our original and your ask.)
- Commit conversion cap: default automatic conversion of unused uptier is capped at 25% of uplift; further changes require written agreement.
- True-ups: quarterly true-ups; invoice credits applied on the next invoice after the uptier window ends.
- Legal/Docs: we'll prepare a short amendment and a one-page accounting memo for finance. DocuSign packet will be sent by EOD Mon.

Next steps: 1) I will route the DocuSign (link below) and attach the amendment; 2) Marcus will send the accounting memo for your finance team; 3) Marissa will schedule a 20-min kickoff with ops for onboarding the uptier.

DocuSign (proposal packet): https://www.docusign.com/rdw/meridian-v4
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/762

If Meridian signs, the renewal effective date will be the later of Apr 1, 2027 or the date the amendment is fully executed — we prefer Apr 1 to align with quarter starts but can accept a mid-Apr effective date if you need.

Thanks — Neha
